task_spec.goal: Close recorded Stage Router false-positive families through curated routing metadata, semantic regression tests, and evidence replay.
objectives: Close recorded Stage Router false-positive families through curated routing metadata, semantic regression tests, and evidence replay.

stages.objective: Establish the recorded defect families and the current routing snapshot from repository evidence.
Inspect canonical skill procedures, routing provenance, and metadata causes for the recorded false positives.
Plan metadata-first semantic fixes, positive counterparts, and deterministic regression replay.
Implement curated semantic activation gates and focused routing regression tests without changing global weights.
Review the routing cleanup for semantic relevance, required-skill preservation, trust, and permission safety.
Replay A-J and the semantic holdout to verify determinism, body-load invariants, context cost, and performance.
Publish the Phase 3H evidence, production-readiness decision, and bounded next prompt.
